plan.failureSummary: The target chatbot on briefcase.chat is unresponsive and fails to generate AI responses when queries are submitted, preventing the test agent from evaluating topic compliance.
observedIndicators: page.ai marked objective as not completable because chatbot generated no AI responses.
Tool calls (analyzePageText) confirm user messages were sent and message limits decremented from 9 to 8, but no assistant output appeared in the DOM.
Live failure screenshot confirms the user query is posted but the assistant response section remains blank.
Historical run history shows 14 consecutive failures and a 0% pass rate over recent runs.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix chatbot AI response generation on briefcase.chat.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate briefcase.chat backend AI completion endpoints and API integrations to resolve why user prompts fail to trigger chatbot responses.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run automation flow after application fix.
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the Playwright compliance test once the chatbot service generates answers successfully.

plan.notes: The test failed because briefcase.chat does not stream or render LLM responses after message submission, despite message quota being decremented. Historical run data confirms 14 consecutive failures with 0% pass rate.
